caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical lantern with a slightly conical top, rendered in neutral tones of grey and brown. The main body of the lantern is predominantly grey metal, featuring numerous small, evenly spaced holes arranged in radiating, patterned lines. The top is brown and perforated with similar holes arranged in a triangular fashion, creating ventilation. Attached to the peak of the top is a large circular metal ring, likely serving as a handle. On the cylindrical body, there is a rectangular door with a small latch, designed for access to the lantern’s interior. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present, and the artist's name "ROSE CAMPBELL-GREINE" is printed in small letters near the bottom right of the image.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
